Reply with one JSON object only: {"decision": "approve"|"reject"|"revalidate", "artifact": "<id of the draft you approve or null>", "result": {"units": <int>} or null, "evidence": [{"id": "<id>", "ver": <int>}, ...], "consulted": [{"id": "<id>", "ver": <int>}, ...]}. evidence = ONLY the artifacts your approved result rests on (its support). Never put a rejected or withdrawn artifact in evidence. Approve only a draft you are confident is current and correct.
